messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> oncall-runtime: Cluster alert: runtime pods in prod-us-west entering crashloop (SIGSEGV). Please ack ASAP.
maria: acked. I'm oncall-runtime. seeing ~25-40% crashloops across runtime-llm replicas in us-west.
ben: oncall-runtime joining. what do logs show?
maria: paste from a failing pod log:```
[2026-03-15T02:14:12Z] Runtime ERROR: unexpected SIGSEGV in fused_attention.cu
#0 0x7fb3e1c4 in fused_attention_forward(cudaStream_t, ...) at fused_attention.cu:142
free(): invalid pointer
```
ben: fused kernel segfault, looks like custom kernel memory corruption. noticed on both T4 and A10 nodes.
ryan: handoff to ben (primary). ben, you have pager.
ben: taking it. quick triage notes: 1) ~48 pods showing restart loops, 2) crash signature consistent SIGSEGV in fused kernel, 3) customer-facing 5xx spikes on generation endpoints (~6-10% for some routes).
alex (support): alerting top-tier customers and posting a short status page message now.
ben: immediate mitigations: a) disable fused kernels to force fallback execution, b) cordon problematic nodes, c) shift new traffic to spare routing pool.
maria: injecting env flag on runtime deployment to disable fused kernels: `REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1` and will roll 10% at a time.
ben: commands used:```
kubectl -n prod set env deploy/runtime-deployment-prod REDWOOD_RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNELS=1
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime-deployment-prod --watch
```
devops-bot: rollout started by ben.
maria: cordoning nodes showing repeated OOM/segfault patterns: ip-10-0-3-12, ip-10-0-3-15. draining now.
ben: routing change: updated ingress router to route new traffic to spare-pool-us-west until rollout stabilizes.
alex (support): status update posted: "Investigating elevated errors for inference in US-WEST. Temporary reroutes and mitigations in place." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ben: after 40% rollout with fused disabled, crashloops dropped from ~30% to about 3-5%. short-term mitigation looks promising.
sam (ml-runtime): copying in. please collect core dumps and `nvidia-smi -q` output from nodes with crashes. probable ABI/driver mismatch or bad kernel build.
ben: `nvidia-smi` from ip-10-0-3-15:```
Driver Version: 535.86
CUDA Version: 12.2
```
sam (ml-runtime): builds for fused kernels in r24.1.0 were compiled against CUDA 12.1 toolchain. 12.2 driver could be the culprit (undefined behavior). also can't rule out double-free in kernel.
maria: preserving one failing pod for core dump and not restarting it until ml-runtime confirms. pod runtime-5f7c9d preserved. cores uploaded to S3 bucket: `s3://redwood-incidents/1816504321/cores/`
ben: launching a small canary rollback to runtime image r24.0.7 on 5 pods to validate.```
kubectl -n prod set image deploy/runtime-deployment-prod runtime=redwood/runtime:r24.0.7 --record
kubectl rollout status deploy/runtime-deployment-prod --watch
```
devops-bot: canary rollback initiated by maria.
ben: canary metrics: canary pods hitting baseline error rates, latency stable. looks good.
alex (support): updated customers: "Mitigation applied; we routed traffic to fallback pools and continue to monitor. No action required on your side." :thumbsup:
sam (ml-runtime): reproducing locally with driver 535.86 against fused kernel binary. initial repro shows same SIGSEGV. collecting debug symbols and will rebuild fused kernels against 12.2 and run cross-driver CI.
ben: next steps assigned: 1) finish global rollout of runtime env disable-fused, 2) collect and archive cores/logs, 3) run rebuild + CI, 4) add runtime startup sanity check for CUDA ABI, 5) add automated canary tests for fused path.
ryan: assigning postmortem owner?
ben: I'll own the postmortem. will write up timeline and root cause hypothesis. ETA EOD tomorrow.
ml-runtime-bot: alerted ml-runtime oncall and opened internal ticket MLR-4523.
maria: full rollout of disable-fused completed; crashloops now <0.5% and 5xxs returned to baseline.
ryan: is incident considered mitigated? alex?
alex (support): priority customers cleared; status page updated to "mitigated, ongoing investigation". closing customer-facing escalations.
ben: root cause hypothesis: fused attention kernels compiled against CUDA 12.1 ABI are incompatible with nodes running 12.2 driver => memory corruption / SIGSEGV. likely compounded by lack of ABI check at startup.
sam (ml-runtime): action items I own: rebuild fused kernels with 12.2 toolchain, extend CI matrix to drivers 12.0-12.3, add startup ABI probe to runtime code, and add canary rollout gates for fused path.
maria: preserving incident artifacts and timeline in `s3://redwood-incidents/1816504321/` and creating postmortem doc.
devops-bot: Incident 1816504321 status -> mitigated.
ben: handing off to ryan for rotation. good job team. will do a blameless postmortem.
ryan: will monitor metrics for 4 hours then close. thanks all.
